description: Your personal information and account security.

password.title: Change password
password.description: First, confirm your current password to receive an email verification code.
password.hint: 8–72 characters, up to 72 UTF-8 bytes; cannot contain only whitespace.
password.success: Password changed. Please sign in again.
password.codeSent: Password change code sent. Check your email.
password.confirmDescription: Use the password change code sent to your account email and choose a new password.
password.localOnly: No local password yet? Choose “Set your first password” in your account.
password.signOutNotice: Changing your password will sign you out. Sign in again with the new password.
password.newCodeHint: Request another email code if yours expires or runs out of attempts.
password.startAgain: Request a new code / back to account
password.missingEmail: Your profile has no valid email. Reload your profile to continue.

setPassword.title: Set your first password
setPassword.description: For Google accounts without a local password. No OTP or current password is needed.

google.title: Link Google
google.description: Choose the Google account with email {{email}} to add this sign-in method.
google.success: Google linked. You can use Google or your existing sign-in method.
google.conflict: Unable to link. Choose the Google account matching your app email. It may already be linked to another account.
